text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... That was exhausting.
This year was even more hectic than the last.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone worked really hard this year.
Let's take a little breather here.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Let's wash away the entire year's fatigue,
clean and refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Let's warm right up♪
Here we go!
